T: Gather the harvest. Keep some for yourself.
D: An inventive ant hires a troupe of circus bugs he thinks are warriors to stand up to the grasshoppers.
P: Serve the snacks when the ants pile up the harvest offering.
S: the seed and grain offering the ants gather
Sunflower, pumpkin, linseed and sesame seeds mixed with chia and water, spread thin, baked at 160C for an hour, broken into shards.
the berries the ants carry across Ant Island
Blueberries and raspberries threaded onto toothpicks with small cubes of feta and a mint leaf, laid out in neat marching lines on a platter.

Popcorn coated in a crunchy brown sugar and butter caramel, baked until glassy, sprinkled with sea salt and handed out in striped cones. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a lidded pot and tip into a big roasting tin. Boil 100g butter, 200g brown sugar, 60ml golden syrup and a pinch of salt for 4 minutes, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb so it foams. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, then spread out to cool and break apart. Sprinkle with flaky salt.
M: the big city made of rubbish

Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and broccoli in an oyster sauce, served in takeaway boxes. Soak 400g fresh egg noodles in hot water for 2 minutes and drain. Slice 500g chicken thigh and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Stir-fry in a very hot wok with oil for 4 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry 1 sliced red capsicum, 1 head broccoli in small florets and 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes with a splash of water. Add the noodles, chicken, 3 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy and toss for 2 minutes. Serve in takeaway boxes with spring onion.
Corn, potato and bacon simmered in stock and milk with onion and thyme, finished with cream and chives.
W: Heimlich the caterpillar finally getting his wings
Shortbread dough rolled out and cut into butterflies, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced in bright colours once cool.
K: the giant dewdrops on the leaves
Cucumber and mint blended with lime and sugar, strained and topped with soda water over ice.

s.note: the seed and grain offering the ants gather
s.how: Mix 60g each of sunflower seeds, pepitas, linseeds and sesame seeds with 40g chia, a pinch of salt and 250ml water. Rest 15 minutes, spread thin and bake at 160C for an hour until crunchy. Break into shards. An offering fit for any colony.

s.note: the berries the ants carry across Ant Island
s.how: Thread blueberries, raspberries, small cubes of feta and a mint leaf onto toothpicks. Lay them out on a long platter in neat marching lines, like ants on the way to the harvest.

m.how: Fry 150g diced bacon, then soften a diced onion. Add 500g diced potatoes, 2 cans of corn, thyme and 1L water and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and blitz a little for body. Serve topped with chives.

w.note: Heimlich the caterpillar finally getting his wings
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g sugar, then mix in 350g flour. Roll out and cut into butterfly shapes. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes and cool. Ice in bright colours with icing sugar and food colouring. One day, a beautiful butterfly.

d.note: the giant dewdrops on the leaves
d.how: Blend a Lebanese cucumber with a handful of mint, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar. Strain into a jug and pour over ice. Top with soda water. Fresh as a dewdrop that looks huge to a very small bug.
